recent_posts.title: Growing your career as a quality and testing professional
recent_posts.summary: A curated list of resources for quality and testing professionals looking to grow their careers. Covers testing-specific platforms (Ministry of Testing, Test Automation University, Quality Leadership Academy), AI and testing guidance (DORA AI Capabilities Model, Beyond Quality research), recommended books (Accelerate, Continuous Delivery), podcasts, and advice on public speaking and conferences. Includes links to communities, courses, practitioners to follow on LinkedIn, and a list of testing conferences.

recent_posts.title: Where did the people-first focus go in the age of AI development
recent_posts.summary: A reflection on how the people-first philosophy of Extreme Programming and early agile movements seems absent from today's AI-assisted development discourse. While XP emphasized psychological safety, collaboration, and team empowerment, the current AI wave appears focused on tools like Claude, Cursor, and Copilot — often at the expense of the humans involved. The author notes that teams struggling before AI adoption tend to struggle even more with it, suggesting the root cause remains a people problem, not a tooling problem.

recent_posts.title: AI, testing, and the DORA AI Capabilities Model
recent_posts.summary: Lisa Crispin discusses a podcast appearance on the Beyond Quality show covering AI, software testing, and the DORA AI Capabilities Model. Key topics include how AI agents degrade over time and the need for continuous agent testing, security pitfalls in GenAI adoption, and how the DORA AI capabilities model can guide teams on their GenAI journey. The post also links to Beyond Quality's research on QA in the age of AI-accelerated development.

recent_posts.title: Continuous quality improvement supported by metrics
recent_posts.summary: Lisa Crispin has created a free, on-demand online course on using metrics to support continuous quality improvement, available through Practitest's Quality Leadership Academy. The ~1-hour course covers setting and prioritizing quality goals, designing small experiments, measuring progress using DORA's four key metrics as examples, and avoiding common pitfalls of metrics misuse. It includes exercises and quizzes designed to make the learning experience practical and hands-on.

recent_posts.title: Holistic Testing with Lisa Crispin
recent_posts.summary: Lisa Crispin discusses holistic testing on the Engineering Quality Podcast, covering how testing should be integrated throughout the entire software development lifecycle with whole-team engagement in building quality. The episode features insights from hosts Ale Moreira, Royalee Martin, and Veronika Pliusnina, and is now available on YouTube.

recent_posts.title: Workshopping ideas for our future in Quality Engineering
recent_posts.summary: Quality Engineers (QEs) are strategic leaders who drive quality culture and continuous improvement across software teams. Key skills include facilitating whole-team quality ownership, advanced communication across roles, risk assessment, and fostering collaboration. QEs need leadership capabilities like empathy, coaching, and the ability to design experiments and measure progress. Technical awareness of systems and tools is important, though coding expertise is debated. Learning paths include mentorship, conferences, communities of practice, and hands-on experimentation. To transform organizations, QEs should establish feedback loops, promote transparency, facilitate risk workshops, and practice value stream management.

recent_posts.title: Recent activities in holistic testing and quality engineering
recent_posts.summary: Lisa Crispin shares updates on her recent activities including a podcast appearance discussing holistic testing and quality culture, a video chat with Janet Gregory, Seb Rose, and Gáspár Nagy about their new BDD book, and the monthly Agile Testing Fellowship newsletter. She also teases an upcoming blog post compiling insights from a quality engineering workshop at Agile Testing Days.

recent_posts.title: Lessons from nature to improve how we work
recent_posts.summary: Building cross-functional relationships is essential for career growth and team success. A book review of 'Nature's Blueprint for Business' explores how natural ecosystems' edge dynamics can inform organizational collaboration strategies. The author shares personal experiences using regular one-on-ones with various departments to identify risks, coordinate dependencies, and create opportunities for mutual support across teams.

recent_posts.title: Get traction on continuous delivery with holistic testing at Agile Testing Days
recent_posts.summary: Lisa Crispin shares her journey from struggling with two-week deployment cycles to achieving continuous delivery success. She discusses how collaboration with experts like Abby Bangser and Ashley Hunsberger led to developing workshops and tutorials that help teams implement holistic testing approaches. The post promotes their upcoming tutorial at Agile Testing Days, which combines the holistic testing model with continuous delivery practices to help teams deliver small batches frequently and confidently.

recent_posts.title: Some ways we can lead for quality
recent_posts.summary: Testing and quality professionals need to step up as quality leaders regardless of their formal role or title. Many agile teams still fall into mini waterfall patterns where developers hand off testing responsibilities to testers at the end of iterations. Quality leaders must make quality problems visible, build relationships across teams, and engage everyone in testing activities throughout the development lifecycle. The post highlights two podcast appearances discussing holistic testing approaches and quality leadership strategies.

top_posts.title: The Agile Testing Quadrants
top_posts.summary: The Agile Testing Quadrants serve as a planning and execution tool to help teams ensure adequate test coverage and build quality. Originating from Brian Marick and popularized by Janet Gregory and Lisa Crispin, these quadrants have evolved over the years. The post encourages using the latest version of the quadrants shared in their book and appreciates suggestions for future updates.

top_posts.title: Agile Testing Days inspiration
top_posts.summary: Agile Testing Days provided a wealth of learning and inspiration. Key experiences included a workshop on LLMs and test-driven development, discussions on professional identity, and a session on using DORA metrics for continuous improvement. The event emphasized the value of community in learning and improvement.

top_posts.title: Learning about AI at Agile Testing Days 2023
top_posts.summary: The article discusses the author's learnings about AI at the Agile Testing Days 2023 conference, including training a machine learning model, ethical aspects of testing AI, and practicing prompt engineering. It emphasizes the combination of art and science in training models, the need for ethical guidelines, and the risks and pitfalls of using generative AI tools.

top_posts.title: The purpose of metrics
top_posts.summary: Measuring things is important for improvement, but it can be challenging to find the right metrics. The culture and environment play a key role in the effectiveness of measurement. Metrics should be used to start conversations and guide small experiments for achieving goals.
